goal: Build a German personal-data form from the given component definitions and contextual UX policy.
countrySelection: Exactly one supplied country key. The selected label must not be edited as free text. A separate temporary search input is allowed. Novel keys forbidden; preserve supplied order.
target: Standalone HTML/CSS/TypeScript plus compiled JS, works locally without network/dependencies.
workflow: Read only task, own input and relevant library/skill files; load only relevant definitions.
Use the capability profiles and project policy to choose the country control. Record decision.json before building the form; include source paths/context facts/reasons.
Implement the chosen original contract and its keyboard/focus/event rules faithfully. Use Input for personal fields; a local filtering provider can be implemented.
Use visible labels, stable unique IDs and meaningful keyboard behavior. Local validation only; no backend or external requests.
Save index.html, form.ts, form.js, styles.css, decision.json, REPORT.md and TRACE.json in own output directory. Report real checks and limitations.
boundaries: Do not read other inputs, outputs, study README/protocol/review/results or historical examples/research.
Do not change library, policy, input or prior files. Write only own output directory.
Do not spawn agents, commit/push, access native apps or research your model identity.
Do not use a not-yet-defined library variant. If requirements cannot be satisfied, document the gap.
